newsitem.title: USA: No consensus yet on ERM stability council - Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: No consensus yet on ERM stability council - Arthuis.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Monday there was no consensus yet for an informal stability council of ministers to oversee monetary union but said he still hoped to win support for his idea.

France has proposed such a council, informally grouping ministers from countries in European monetary union after its launch in 1999, to counterbalance the future European Central Bank (ECB), which will run monetary policy.

"Although it is true the stability council does not have total consensus, I am confident we shall reach a consensus in the future," he told a news conference at the annual meeting of the World Bank and International Monetary Fund.
"We all realise the need to have a political body which stands side-by-side with the ECB," he said.
